## Checklist

- [ ] `python tools/test_all.py` passes
- [ ] `python -m clarent doctor` passes (run with `PYTHONPATH=src`)
- [ ] `python tools/build_plugin.py` was run and its output is committed (if a skill changed)
- [ ] Every source is marked `read` / `exists` / `blocked` / `unverified` honestly
- [ ] Constants that are not from the original source are listed under *Limitations*
- [ ] Prior-art scan date is recent and recorded in the card
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
